'''Wardpost Thrantus''' was an outpost used by [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] that was located at the eastern end of the [[Riverside Graze]] in [[Kaamos Territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]] tested the [[Brood Totem]] against the wardpost, causing it to be attacked by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].
